actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable biological phenotype (oxidative phosphorylation/ROS, immune-inflammatory, and proliferative-metabolic programs up-enriched versus rest; ER:0155eb9d7205:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e9f462ede3), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on membership/boundary is weak: set-level native-geometry alignment shows only small positive silhouettes (CT 0.013, RNA 0.079, WSI 0.050, WXS 0.091) with small within-versus-between distance gaps (ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e9f462ede3), and the pair-level structural diagnostic shows a near-zero boundary silhouette (0.0003) with pooled within-set affinity (0.00932) only marginally above between-set affinity (0.00902) (ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:fbf65f89cc). Merge is not a legal structural action in this workflow, so the weak boundary cannot be repaired by union, and no supported internal subdivision is available. With independent retention not positively justified and decision-relevant membership evidence exhausted, drop is appropriate for this run.
